snapshot.title: Dedicated mission debrief screen and flow
snapshot.description: Add dedicated mission debrief flow as specified in .knowns/assets/IMG_1755.jpeg (formal ticket note) and consistent with overall notes in .knowns/assets/IMG_1754.jpeg + .knowns/assets/IMG_1756.jpeg.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Completing a mission transitions into a dedicated debrief screen
Debrief presents mission outcome summary without breaking current progression
Flow back to mission selection/next step is deterministic

changes.newValue:
Validated dedicated debrief flow against .knowns/assets/IMG_1755.jpeg (formal debrief requirement) with context from .knowns/assets/IMG_1754.jpeg and .knowns/assets/IMG_1756.jpeg.
- Confirmed return transitions route to res://Scenes/Earth/mission_debrief.tscn (dedicated debrief step).
- Added deterministic empty-state handling in MissionDebrief.gd: when returned mission context is missing, actions are locked and UI explicitly routes player to continue via Back.
- Re-ran run_experience_tests.gd headless: 19/19 pass.
